capacity: Planning envelope: 6 implementation days + 2 integrated verification days + 1 review/refinement day + 1 contingency day; not measured velocity. One primary outcome in progress; at most two closely related workflow slices. Story/task pairs share effort, not double-counted work.
commitment: Existing active sprint remains active with original dates; only its goal/name and unfinished membership are reorganized. Every new sprint is future and undated. No fabricated story-point/time estimates or assignees. The ordered slots are a provisional work breakdown, not a fixed delivery forecast. Before activation, split any candidate exceeding six implementation days and verify reviewer/provider readiness; preserve all parent acceptance criteria.

sprints.name: Build and paid-access guardrails
sprints.goal: Make the clean-checkout verification reliable and close the two bounded production checkout guardrail defects.
sprints.exit: Pipeline parity passes; unconfigured paid production checkout and unauthorized plan selection are rejected with regression evidence. Existing active sprint dates stay unchanged.

sprints.name: Canonical ownership contracts
sprints.goal: Finish the remaining field/ownership inventory and agree the contracts needed by subsequent slices.
sprints.exit: Current/proposed ownership, money/null/version semantics and raw-SQL/service-owned fields are reviewed; unresolved mappings are explicit.

sprints.name: Database integrity and CI
sprints.goal: Enforce the reviewed tenant/reference/state constraints and make drift detectable in CI.
sprints.exit: Valid legacy fixtures migrate; direct invalid writes and concurrent duplicates fail; model/migration drift checks pass.

sprints.name: Flexible schema and revision contracts
sprints.goal: Specify and validate stable typed core facts plus versioned JSON extensions and immutable temporal references.
sprints.exit: Old/new schemas remain readable; missing/conflicting/zero are distinct; effective/recorded/valuation times and revision links are tested.

sprints.name: Currency propagation and precision
sprints.goal: Complete remaining money writers/readers against the existing explicit currency policy.
sprints.exit: Supported precision and provenance are enforced across remaining consumers; unknown legacy currencies remain unresolved; approved backfill mappings are prepared, not guessed.

sprints.name: Truthful financial views
sprints.goal: Finish one financial-truth outcome across existing board, portfolio and Marketplace views, reusing the currency contract.
sprints.exit: No mixed-currency sums, unowned-return pollution, pending-as-funded amounts or live illustrative totals; unavailable states and exact-version action gates pass interaction and API tests.

sprints.name: Document financial provenance
sprints.goal: Preserve source-backed parties, amounts, currency, units and valuation from documents.
sprints.exit: Ambiguous/conflicting facts remain review issues; each accepted fact resolves to a document/page/table anchor and exact version.

sprints.name: Reliable intake execution
sprints.goal: Close the original ingestion epic criteria for duplicate deliveries, worker restart, cancellation and provider failure.
sprints.exit: The configured pilot intake channels persist one submission/artifact chain; partial failure, replay and dead-letter recovery retain evidence without duplicate side effects.

sprints.name: Authorized evidence search
sprints.goal: Implement tenant-scoped indexing and exact artifact retrieval on the evidenced intake chain.
sprints.exit: Authorized users retrieve original financial evidence; cross-tenant, duplicate indexing and retention/deletion cases pass.

sprints.name: Document-generated review forms
sprints.goal: Deliver reviewable LLM-generated structured forms on pinned evidence and validated component contracts.
sprints.exit: Sparse/conflicting/unfamiliar/repeated/hostile-document corpus passes; extensions and evidence survive; unsafe output and provider failures cannot replace the active form.

sprints.name: Safe regeneration and activation
sprints.goal: Connect effective financial revisions and preserve human corrections during regeneration.
sprints.exit: Stable semantic/entity matching survives reorder; material changes identify stale pricing/quotes/approvals; one effective revision and historical replay are proven.

sprints.name: Indexed rebuildable projections
sprints.goal: Deliver authorized submission/party projections with consistent pagination and rebuild semantics.
sprints.exit: Counts, currency totals and source checkpoints reconcile after rebuild; query plans and latency meet an explicitly recorded pilot workload.

sprints.name: Submission readiness
sprints.goal: Make missing/conflicting generated-form information actionable without rejecting valid drafts.
sprints.exit: Issues have owner and resolution; configured publication/quote/bind gates re-evaluate against the current revision; stale readiness cannot authorize a transition.

sprints.name: Underwriting work queue
sprints.goal: Expose one prioritized queue with ownership, deadlines, referrals and exact deep links.
sprints.exit: Assignment/escalation, stable sort/pagination, current access and return-to-queue interactions pass.

sprints.name: Remaining financial identity adapters
sprints.goal: Finish canonical ownership/funding/collateral/payout identity mappings without inventing identities.
sprints.exit: Owning-domain adapters and unresolved legacy records are explicit; social consent never grants financial authority. Downstream provider journeys revalidate these mappings later.

sprints.name: Counterparty transaction review
sprints.goal: Apply the approved transaction-specific policy using current EnsuredAPI submissions, insured subjects and role evidence.
sprints.exit: Reviewed policy and accountable reviewer are recorded; stale/revoked/unavailable evidence blocks/refers; participant approval is not universal clearance.

sprints.name: Beneficiary mandates
sprints.goal: Enforce verified payout destinations and independent payment approval.
sprints.exit: Beneficiary changes invalidate prior approval; unauthorized changes/self-approval are rejected; statement-view mandates remain separate.

sprints.name: Rating-basis correctness
sprints.goal: Repair the two bounded pricing-input/output correctness gaps before experience modeling.
sprints.exit: Configured revenue/payroll/TIV basis is selected correctly; unavailable premium remains distinct from a genuine approved zero.

sprints.name: Loss experience into pricing
sprints.goal: Reconcile approved loss/exposure experience and feed it into existing credibility pricing.
sprints.exit: Gross/net, paid/incurred, dates and currency reconcile; duplicates and exceptional losses are reviewed; no-experience and qualified-experience known answers pass.

sprints.name: Defensible pricing review
sprints.goal: Publish reviewed model methods and expose reproducible results and overrides.
sprints.exit: Independent known answers and two unlike configured classes pass; model/input versions and override authority replay exactly. Portfolio stress extension is verified in its later sprint.

sprints.name: Capacity lifecycle
sprints.goal: Use authoritative facility balances and complete the pending reservation/expiry/release slice of capital lifecycle.
sprints.exit: Concurrent allocation cannot exceed limits; unknown currency/capacity cannot authorize bind; retry/expiry/cancellation releases once. External funded-capital work remains under AIN-36.

sprints.name: Underwriting authority and referrals
sprints.goal: Enforce reviewed decision authority, explicit exceptions and independent approvals.
sprints.exit: Over-limit/expired/delegated/manual paths enforce policy server-side; material source changes invalidate approval. Bind event integration remains under AIN-26.

sprints.name: Incremental portfolio accumulation
sprints.goal: Show the current and proposed concentration of evidenced underlying exposure.
sprints.exit: Overlapping participations are deduplicated by evidenced identity; gross/ceded/retained and currency views reconcile; concurrent updates require re-evaluation.

sprints.name: Delegated facility oversight
sprints.goal: Monitor mandate usage, exceptions and overdue reporting with current authority.
sprints.exit: Expired/revoked grants and over-limit activity are controlled; exceptions have owners and retained evidence.

sprints.name: Document-derived treaty terms
sprints.goal: Make reviewed facultative/treaty wording available as typed, versioned executable semantics.
sprints.exit: Unfamiliar clauses remain extensions; supported-economics matrix is explicit; ambiguous/unsupported terms cannot silently drive a generic calculation.

sprints.name: Quote-to-bind handoff
sprints.goal: Bind the exact approved terms and consume capacity with a durable financial/servicing handoff.
sprints.exit: One idempotent bind produces one contract/capacity effect and recoverable obligations; stale approval/signature alone cannot bind.

sprints.name: Recipient-specific disclosure
sprints.goal: Replace all-or-nothing sharing with immutable, previewed recipient packages.
sprints.exit: Nested fields/documents are actually omitted or redacted in API/export payloads; changed audience/content invalidates consent; revocation blocks future platform access.

sprints.name: Comparable quotations
sprints.goal: Compare current offers and material wording differences using evidence-backed semantic bindings.
sprints.exit: Different deductible/coverage bases and missing terms are shown accurately; changed or expired offers cannot be accepted as current.

sprints.name: Client recommendation approval
sprints.goal: Present a private client recommendation and retain exact-terms approval.
sprints.exit: Client authority, package hash and version are recorded; material changes invalidate approval without rewriting history or implying insurer binding.

sprints.name: Issued contract documents
sprints.goal: Issue and deliver exact bound artifacts with explicit lifecycle states.
sprints.exit: Draft/issued/superseded states, source hash, delivery retry and access revocation are verified; missing required terms block issuance.

sprints.name: Client workspace
sprints.goal: Project existing client submissions, placement and servicing into one authorized workspace.
sprints.exit: No duplicate client or ledger; permitted counts/deep links, ownership/next actions, pagination and partial-service outages are verified.

sprints.name: Market approaches
sprints.goal: Track authorized approaches, responses, declines and remaining placement work.
sprints.exit: Delivery is evidenced rather than inferred; retries do not duplicate recipients; revised packages/offers and remaining capacity reconcile.

sprints.name: Broker handover and follow-up
sprints.goal: Make client responsibility transfers and permitted introduction follow-up accountable.
sprints.exit: Handover retains decisions/deadlines; assignment is not access; private follow-ups do not leak through Network and stale commercial links are denied.

sprints.name: Effective market discovery
sprints.goal: Make supported Marketplace filtering/sorting effective and explain source freshness for matching.
sprints.exit: Map/list/table inventory agrees under filters; unknown/stale appetite is not represented as willingness to quote; permissions and exact source links hold.

sprints.name: Premium and commission accruals
sprints.goal: Implement the accrual/invoice and typed basis slice of AIN-37 using the existing party subledger.
sprints.exit: Reviewed gross-to-net example reconciles by party/currency; quoted, earned and due states remain distinct; unsupported commission economics remain unavailable.

sprints.name: Premium receipts and adjustments
sprints.goal: Finish supported premium/commission/tax/fee lifecycle and its user workflow.
sprints.exit: Partial receipts, supported variable commission boundaries and reversal requirements reconcile; actual provider receipt evidence is required before settlement claims.

sprints.name: Provider funding handoff
sprints.goal: Implement one approved provider sandbox call/receipt handoff, with persisted operation and uncertain-result recovery.
sprints.exit: Timeout-after-success, duplicate/out-of-order events and failed persistence recover to one matched receipt; no simulated event is called confirmed cash.

sprints.name: Funding and collateral reconciliation
sprints.goal: Complete funded-capital/custody/collateral reconciliation and authorized release on the approved provider scope.
sprints.exit: Partial/reversed/unmatched statements, mandate changes and release limits reconcile by party/currency; attach provider-sandbox evidence. Reuse earlier capacity slice.

sprints.name: Management financial metrics
sprints.goal: Expose current reconciled management KPIs and source drill-through.
sprints.exit: Definitions, ownership, freshness, missing coverage and currencies are explicit; rebuilt metrics reconcile to authoritative transactions.

sprints.name: Contractual reports and bordereaux
sprints.goal: Track obligations and validate document-derived reporting without losing unfamiliar evidence.
sprints.exit: Revised/duplicate rows and period/currency discrepancies enter resolution; accepted reports update one current projection with retained history.

sprints.name: Layer and reinstatement economics
sprints.goal: Calculate supported multilayer protection and reinstatement effects from approved terms.
sprints.exit: Independent boundary, aggregate exhaustion and reinstatement premium/coverage cases pass; unsupported clauses block computation.

sprints.name: Endorsements and cancellation
sprints.goal: Amend bound coverage with effective-date, financial and capacity adjustments.
sprints.exit: Limit endorsement and cancellation after partial premium payment reconcile; retries do not double-release/refund; prior coverage and approvals remain historical.

sprints.name: Operational claims workflow
sprints.goal: Replace sample claims with durable intake, review, reserves and adjudication linked to bound coverage.
sprints.exit: Document-derived evidence/conflicts and current roles are exercised; recognized/disputed/paid/outstanding states reconcile to existing servicing.

sprints.name: Cash reversal integration
sprints.goal: Connect original-event-linked reversals across premium, recovery and capital provider workflows.
sprints.exit: Repeated/partial/over-limit reversal tests preserve immutable evidence and reconcile provider outcome separately from local adjustment.

sprints.name: Recoveries and beneficiary waterfalls
sprints.goal: Complete party recoverables, approved distributions and evidenced receipts/payments.
sprints.exit: Known-answer priorities/rounding, disputes, insufficient cash, partial receipts and reversals reconcile; beneficiary authority and provider sandbox evidence pass.

sprints.name: Parametric trigger review
sprints.goal: Close the original claims epic requirement for authenticated trigger observations and reviewable parametric payouts.
sprints.exit: Pinned observations and approved trigger/formula versions reproduce the payout; duplicate/conflicting triggers and disputes cannot cause duplicate payments.

sprints.name: Outward protection traceability
sprints.goal: Trace retrocession through underlying versions, amendments and losses.
sprints.exit: Two outward covers cannot duplicate or cycle recoveries; ceded/retained amounts and remaining protection reconcile by version/currency.

sprints.name: Reproducible stress scenarios
sprints.goal: Compare baseline/proposed portfolio stress without changing booked positions.
sprints.exit: Pinned model/portfolio scenarios replay; known-answer layer effects and missing-data limits are visible; no live ledger writes occur.

sprints.name: Renewal preparation
sprints.goal: Assemble renewal dossiers from evidenced experience, changes and outstanding servicing.
sprints.exit: Open recovery/changed exposure is visible; fresh periods and approvals are required; predecessor history and compatible corrections are preserved.

sprints.name: Idempotent subscription checkout
sprints.goal: Prevent duplicate external subscriptions and recover uncertain checkout outcomes.
sprints.exit: Concurrent checkout, timeout-after-provider-success and DB failure converge to one intended provider subscription.

sprints.name: Billing lifecycle and entitlements
sprints.goal: Finish lifecycle events, usage/invoice reconciliation and customer access behavior.
sprints.exit: Renewal/past-due/cancellation/refund/out-of-order cases converge; usage totals and receivables match provider invoices/payments; customer change/cancel paths pass.

sprints.name: Pilot system adapter contracts
sprints.goal: Pin the named pilot policy/claims/accounting adapter scope and deliver its first bounded end-to-end handoff.
sprints.exit: Authoritative writers, IDs and semantic mappings are documented; a named sandbox exchange passes deduplication, stale-input and rejected-mapping cases.

sprints.name: External system reconciliation
sprints.goal: Finish the remaining explicitly agreed pilot adapter mappings and recovery/reconciliation workflows.
sprints.exit: Every supported adapter passes vendor sandbox duplicate/out-of-order/uncertain outcome tests; counts/versions/currencies reconcile. Split further before activation if the agreed adapter set exceeds one developer sprint.

sprints.name: Legacy migration rehearsal
sprints.goal: Rehearse additive migrations/backfills and compatible application cutover on representative legacy data.
sprints.exit: All delivered migrations, including identity/participation additions, have reviewed mappings or quarantine; idempotent batches and rollback preserve immutable history.

sprints.name: Restore and operational recovery
sprints.goal: Prove cross-service restore, interrupted-job recovery and external outcome reconciliation.
sprints.exit: Recorded recovery targets, restored versions/counts/balances and provider replay are verified; rollback never implies cash reversal.

sprints.name: Financial invariant release gate
sprints.goal: Reconcile the full coverage register and execute cross-party failure injection across all delivered financial domains.
sprints.exit: Conservation, concurrency, replay, provider uncertainty and restore evidence pass; unresolved risks and scope limits are explicit, not silently waived.

sprints.name: Staged persona acceptance
sprints.goal: Certify the agreed pilot and capital scope across two unlike configured classes and all three personas.
sprints.exit: Baseline/measured outcomes, exact build versions, Storybook/API/provider evidence, accessibility, owner sign-off and rollback criteria are recorded; every required child/epic gate is reconciled.

intake.summary: [Sprint slice] Verify intake worker resilience and artifact lineage
intake.description: Required original AIN-2 acceptance is broader than its evidence/search children. For the configured pilot intake channels, test duplicate delivery, worker restart, cancellation, timeout, dead-letter/replay and persisted searchable lineage. Preserve existing ingestion packages. Backend integration evidence links to AIN-87; any changed UI needs executable stories. This is missing coverage, not a second ingestion engine.

capacity-slice.summary: [Sprint slice] Finish pending commitment expiry and capacity release
capacity-slice.description: Bounded early slice of AIN-36: pending acceptance/cancellation/expiry and exactly-once release of unconsumed capacity using current commitment receipts and commercial ledger. Verify concurrency, stale source and duplicate commands. No provider funding/custody/cash work is included in this slice; AIN-36 retains that later obligation. This slice unblocks AIN-88 without requiring funded-capital completion before binding.

premium-slice.summary: [Sprint slice] Implement premium and commission accrual contracts
premium-slice.description: Bounded early slice of AIN-37: reviewed amount/rate/basis semantics, party/currency attribution, earned/payable rules and idempotent accrual/invoice posting. Known-answer gross-to-net and supported variable commission examples are required. Receipts/provider reconciliation/reversals and full AIN-89 acceptance remain in the following sprint.

funding-slice.summary: [Sprint slice] Verify persisted provider funding operations and receipts
funding-slice.description: Bounded provider handoff slice of AIN-36: approved provider sandbox, persisted operation, signed event intake, call/receipt correlation, deduplication and timeout-after-success recovery. Use existing outbox/inbox. Actual sandbox evidence required; custody/collateral position reconciliation and release remain under AIN-36/90 in the following sprint.

parametric.summary: [Claims] Review authenticated parametric triggers and payout decisions
parametric.description: As a claims reviewer, I want authenticated trigger observations tied to the approved contract and formula so I can verify parametric payout decisions and resolve disputes without duplicate payments. This preserves the original AIN-10 parametric scope, which lacked an explicit child. Pin observation/source/time, trigger/formula/contract versions; retain conflicting/late observations and independent review; show unavailable providers; calculate reproducible payout and use existing authorized payment/beneficiary workflow. LLM-extracted trigger wording is a review proposal, never authoritative observation or payout approval.

integration-slice.summary: [Sprint slice] Validate named pilot adapter mappings and first handoff
integration-slice.description: Bounded first slice of AIN-119: record the supported named pilot systems, owners, API/schema versions and approved access; implement first concrete policy/claims/accounting exchange with semantic IDs and outbox/inbox. Verify actual vendor sandbox acknowledgement and duplicate/out-of-order handling. Remaining supported adapters and end-to-end reconciliation stay under AIN-119; do not claim all integrations from one connector or a mock.

epic_dependency_rule: Historical epic-level Blocks links remain intact as delivery/release constraints. Readiness for a child uses the named prerequisite milestone, not completion of every late child of a foundational epic. AIN-1 provides build/staging foundations early and full integration/restore late; AIN-47 contracts are early and legacy cutover late. No epic is closed at an early milestone.
scope: All 17 epics reviewed: 14 open epics sequenced; 3 Done Network epics preserved as reusable evidence. Every unfinished non-epic issue and subtask is assigned; no related work is silently excluded. Completed issues retain current sprint/history and status. Existing acceptance criteria and hierarchy remain unchanged.
gates: Each sprint must meet the affected issue AC/DoD, including executable Storybook action/payload assertions and isolated Docker integration where applicable.
Generated forms remain documentation-driven with evidence anchors, stable semantic/entity IDs, reviewed corrections and explicit activation; LLM output grants no authority.

Provider/vendor-dependent candidates cannot be activated as executable commitments until approved provider scope, sandbox access and reviewer availability are established. Work on mocks does not satisfy settlement/integration acceptance.
Migrations and operational readiness are verified incrementally per story and rehearsed globally before launch. No separate late testing phase substitutes for per-sprint verification.
Business/actuarial/compliance review is external to the one developer capacity; missing review is an explicit dependency, not invented sign-off.
